newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore oil products market mixed, gas oil dips.
newsitem.headline: Singapore oil products market mixed, gas oil dips.

text.p: Singapore oil products prices were mixed on Friday with middle and light distillates weaker while fuel oil was steady amid aggressive bids, traders said.

A German trader sold 220,000 barrels of September 29-October 1 gas oil at $27.40 a barrel to a Singapore trader. Another Singapore trader bid for 240,000 barrels of early October gas oil at $27.60, with a major offering 150,000 barrels for mid-October lifting at $27.80. Gas oil swaps also dipped with October traded at $27.30 and $27.40, down 10-20 cents from Thursday. Traders said the softer tone on London's IPE gas oil has contributed to the lower levels in Singapore.

Jet fuel also slipped with a US trader offering at $29.40 for a 220,000-barrel cargo lifting October 11-15. The market should get some boost from Vietnam which is almost doubling its oil products requirements--gas oil, kerosene, jet fuel and gasoline--for the fourth quarter to 609,000 tonnes. The tender closes on September 27.

Gasoline was traded lower with aggressive selling. A Dutch trader sold two 50,000 barrel-parcels of 95-octane unleaded at $22.90 and $22.60 a barrel fob Singapore, respectively to a Singapore and a Japanese trader. These were under offers of $23.20 earlier in the day and below Thursday's deals at $23.10.

Traders said fundamentally the gasoline market is balanced in October with exports to Africa, Australia and even South America having taken out the region's surplus. But uncertainty loomed for November and December as China's new Dalian refinery which starts trial runs at the end of September, could start exporting 40,000 bpd.

Fuel oil remained well-supported with 180-cst for October lifting bid at $117 a tonne fob, up from Thursday's bid/asked at $115/$117. Traders said the return of Chinese demand has also helped to boost levels with bids at $122-$124 a tonne c+f South China, traders said.--Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3084)
